title: Sunlight Exposure and Vitamin D in Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the amount of sunlight exposure and vitamin D status of adolescent schoolchildren in each season throughout the year.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy school children aged 12-15 years
* White Caucasian
* Male or female

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of photosensitivity disorder
